<thought>Using typical 13C chemical shift ranges, methyl (CH₃) carbons appear around 10‑30 ppm for simple alkyl groups and near 55‑60 ppm for methoxy (O‑CH₃). In the spectrum the peaks at 57.20, 24.56, 19.40, and 16.60 ppm fall within these methyl regions, giving four methyl carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
